signals.H: Predictive entropy normalized by log(number of classes)

familiarity_validation: Zero prediction mismatches for all architectures and folds
split_method: Stratified train_test_split within each OOF fold; first split creates meta-training and remainder; second split divides remainder into calibration and test.
threshold_rule: Threshold selected from calibration error scores only; test samples flagged when risk score >= threshold.
